facts.fact: The record of USAID's Collaborative Support for Health Systems Strengthening programme (US$21,257,274 committed, US$21,257,253 disbursed, 2015 to 2022) states that it supported the national HMIS, iHRIS and electronic data capture for PEPFAR reporting; the share of the money for HMIS is not given, health information systems being one element of a broad programme.

note: An excerpt-only deal record, withdrawn from the finance register; it names the HMIS without describing what it does, and the programme ended in 2022.
